description: R-MFDN runs used in the report. Axes: protocol p1 (official IDForge split) / p2 (identity-disjoint); identity i1 (identity reference on) / i3 (reference off). cross_modal is always m1, the R-MFDN progressive cross-attention fusion. A run is named <cross_modal>_<identity>_<protocol>_<modalities>, e.g. m1_i3_p2_VAT. p2/i3 VA and VAT: reproduction (C1). p2/i1 VAT against p2/i3 VAT: identity-reference claim (C2). p1/i3 VA: official-split baseline, also the control of the improvement experiment.
